Beyond the tasks measured

Every number on this page is for a named program on a named machine against a named Python version. The server results come from one run on each of two cloud machines; an Intel Xeon server measured Guion slower on an earlier build, and GitHub's standard runners no longer offer one, so that result is unresolved. The Apple Silicon results were measured on early-November builds and have not been re-run on 0.5.0. Free-threaded Python and PyPy were not compared.

Overall competitiveness remains open, in the project's own words.
